verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents an auto-shutdown feature that stops a machine after inactivity (from 1 hour to 1 week), directly addressing the 'forgotten instance' risk, and this is corroborated by official docs. However, there is no evidence of configurable spend/budget limits or billing caps, which is the other half of the story. missing for 10: documented spend-limit/budget-cap feature, independent hands-on confirmation that auto-shutdown reliably prevents runaway billing.
